titleEn: I Want to Sit Beside Mom

pages.text: "Mom, look at me!" Mina tapped her knee. Sonu was snug on Mom's lap. Outside, rain poured, and the river kept rising.
"Hug me, too. Look at me!" Mina wanted her attention. With a hand on Sonu's forehead, Mom only nodded. "Sonu has a fever. Wait a little."
Mina left the room and sat on the threshold. Drops from the roof splashed their feet. Inside, only Sonu's fussing could be heard.
Lamplight stretched through the door's gap, making Mina's anklet shine. "I'm here, too..." Both ears drooped.
Mom called and opened one arm. "You wanted a hug, too. Come beside me." Mina approached and leaned into her arm.
"Shall I bring a towel?" Mina asked. "Thank you. Would you?" Mina wet one in the tub beside the door and wrung it tightly.
Mom gently laid the towel Mina brought on Sonu's forehead. Mina sat nearby and quietly held a hand.
Mom looked at Mina. "Thank you for the towel. Rest beside me now." Mina nodded.
Sonu fell asleep gripping Mina's finger. Mina waited quietly without pulling away. Only rain sounded in the room.
Mom brought Mina onto her lap, too. There was plenty of room for both. "I'll care for Sonu. You rest, too." Mina leaned against her.
